items.t: Man sentenced to life in prison for deadly 2024 shooting at Sarasota County park
items.x: A man will now spend the rest of his life behind bars after being found guilty of a shooting that left one person dead in 2024.

items.t: 18th Annual Dog-A-Ween costume contest
items.x: Sarasota’s Halloween tradition returned this year for the 18th Annual Dog-A-Ween Costume Contest

items.t: BMX Racing World Cup: Historic Sarasota track hosts international tour finale
items.x: More than 200 elite cyclists from across the globe have converged on Sarasota for a high-stakes competition that could pave their path to the 2028 Olympic Games.

items.t: Sarasota man convicted of murder after argument over noise turns deadly: State attorney
items.x: A man accused of killing someone over an argument has been convicted of second-degree murder by a Sarasota jury, the State Attorney's Office said.

items.t: VIDEO: Teen jumps from 2nd floor of Sarasota apartment to avoid arrest
items.x: Newly released video captured the arrest of a teen who jumped from the second floor of a apartment building while attempting to flee from Sarasota police officers.

items.t: Man loses $6,000 in Sarasota horse-buying scam
items.x: Sarasota County detectives shut down a fraudulent website after a Colorado man lost $6,000 in a horse-buying scam, officials said.

items.t: Stamkos scores in regulation and only goal in shootout to lead Predators over Lightning 5-4
items.x: Steven Stamkos scored the tying goal in regulation and the only goal of the shootout to lead the Nashville Predators to a 5-4 victory over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Saturday.

items.t: Hillsborough deputies seek tips 4 years after 15-year-old killed in Halloween party shooting
items.x: Deputies are asking the community for help as the fourth anniversary approaches of a Halloween party shooting that took the life of a teenage girl.

items.t: Ambulance driver accused of abandoning patient, said he was ‘done driving for the day’ and called an Uber home
items.x: An Ohio ambulance driver is accused of leaving a patient with chest pain during a trip to the Cleveland Clinic after reportedly getting lost in Cleveland.

items.t: DOJ pushes to isolate Alaska ballots in Peltola probe
items.x: The Department of Justice (DOJ) pushed to isolate some Alaska ballots as part of a probe into whether the presence of two candidates with the same name could confuse voters in the state, a Friday court filing shows.

items.t: Trooper catches a ride from good Samaritan while chasing reckless driver in Pinellas Park
items.x: Law enforcement released video footage on Saturday of a good Samaritan helping a trooper catch a reckless driver in Pinellas Park.

items.t: 10 Tampa Bay Weather: Breezy conditions continue ahead of Sunday showers
items.x: Halloween looks mainly dry and warm across Tampa Bay before a front brings a better chance of showers on Sunday.

items.t: Hillsborough County elections office preps for Tuesday as early voting window nears its end
items.x: With early voting ending Sunday, election officials are urging voters to review their sample ballots and know their polling location before Tuesday.

items.t: Pregnant woman killed, 6 others hurt in shooting at Halloween store in California
items.x: One person died and six others were hurt in a shooting Friday night at a Spirit Halloween store in Northern California.

items.t: Chewy cookie bars designed for toddlers recalled over choking hazard
items.x: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration is urging parents to not give a brand of soft-baked bars to toddlers because they could create a potentially fatal choking hazard.

items.t: In-person early voting hits record pace for midterms
items.x: A record 51.3 million ballots have been cast ahead of Election Day, continuing the growing trend of Americans voting early.

items.t: Valkyries determined to avoid another slow start in WNBA Finals Game 7 against Dream
items.x: There shouldn't be a problem with the Golden State Valkyries and Atlanta Dream approaching the first WNBA Finals Game 7 in league history with a sense of urgency.

items.t: ‘I Voted’ sticker creator talks about how it started
items.x: The “I Voted” sticker given to people who cast ballots began with one woman, Janet Boudreau, who designed it after seeing a local county hand out a different sticker on Election Day.

items.t: Holmberg has a career-high 4 points as the Lightning beat the Jets 6-4 to remain unbeaten at home
items.x: Pontus Holmberg set a career high with four points on a goal and three assists, Brandon Hagel and Anthony Cirelli each had a goal and two assists, and the Tampa Bay Lightning remain unbeaten at home with a 6-4 victory over the Winnipeg…

items.t: Hillsborough deputies arrest 30 sex offenders during 'Operation Scarecrow'
items.x: The Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office arrested 30 registered sex offenders in October as part of "Operation Scarecrow," an effort to ensure compliance with registration and probation requirements ahead of Halloween.
